rdf:Description.skos:description: This ticket covers the creation of the `main.py` and `streamlit_app.py` files. These files will provide a command-line interface and a user-facing web application for the `gbad_core` library.
rdf:Description.skos:scopeNote: **Context:** The refactored `gbad_core` library needs user-friendly interfaces to make it accessible to both developers and non-technical users.
rdf:Description.skos:changeNote: **Implementation Plan:** 1. **Create `main.py` for CLI:** - Use the `click` library to create a command-line interface. - The CLI should accept arguments for the Draw.io files, CSV files, a configuration file, and the output file path. - It will then instantiate the `gbad_core.pipeline.Pipeline` with the loaded configuration and run the conversion process. 2. **Create `streamlit_app.py` for Web App:** - Use the `streamlit` library to create the web application. - The UI should allow users to: - Upload one or more Draw.io files. - Upload one or more CSV files. - Optionally, upload a custom configuration file. - Click a "Run" button to start the conversion process. - Download the resulting N-Quads file. - The app will use the `gbad_core.pipeline.Pipeline` to run the conversion process in the background.
